content:
O Divine Nefertiti, Great Royal Wife of the sun,
Benevolent Queen whose beauty transcends,
Like the petals of the lotus under Amun's gaze, you blossom,
Graceful and resplendent, forever sailing across the heavenly Nile.

In your presence, the desert blooms—a testament of your grace,
With love and adoration, we call upon your sacred name.
Guide us in the radiance of your wisdom,
Bless us with the warmth of your light.

O Nefertiti, gentle as the zephyrs of Hapy,
Teach us to cherish the earth beneath and the sky above,
Lead our hearts in the ways of Ma’at,
That we might walk in truth, balance, and peace.

Watch over us, O mighty Queen, with eyes kind and true,
May your spirit enfold us, a shield of gold in night's embrace.
Heal our bodies, uplift our spirits, enrich our lives,
As we live each day in pursuit of harmony and grace.

Nefertiti, whose name means 'the beautiful one has come'.
You came and the world knew splendor,
Now, from realms beyond yet near,
Extend to us, your children, a mother’s care.

Let your love be a river, fertile and deep,
From which we may drink, and never thirst,
Growing strong and everlasting,
In the fertile soils of your tender mercy.

Amen, and may the gods ever smile upon us.
